purpose: DeepSeek orchestrator combo registry — the CORRECT MCP-combo prompts to dispatch to worker agents. One lane = one pit-stop choreography, never single-step fumbles.
rules: LANE-LOCK FIRST: the agent must flux_swarm_claim before editing. Claiming after = dup-work collision.
CHECK BEFORE BUILD: flux_swarm_status + flux_swarm_inbox first, so two agents don't build the same crate.
COMBO, DON'T SINGLE-STEP: flux_combo does compile+test+predict in ONE call. Never run them separately.
FAIL-CLOSED ON MONEY: a trade settles only on 2-of-2 debate SETTLE. Unparseable auditor = VETO.
GATED COMPUTE: never auto-rent. search_offers, surface to operator, operator triggers create_instance.
SHIP -> SETTLE -> BROADCAST: flux_swarm_complete to settle QUG, then flux_swarm_message so siblings reuse, not rebuild.
GUARD TEARDOWN: may_destroy(agent,id) before destroy_instance. A box may be a sibling's lane.

BUILD.when: scaffold/edit/fix a Rust crate in the Flux or SIGIL workspace
combo: flux_swarm_register {agent}
flux_swarm_claim {lane}
flux_architect_predict {crate}   # predict cold-build cost BEFORE scaffolding (avoid OOM/surprise)
flux_combo {file}                # compile+test+predict in ONE call
IF errors: flux_qspec {error}  ->  apply fix  ->  flux_combo (re-verify ZERO)
flux_swarm_complete {lane}       # settle QUG
flux_swarm_message {broadcast what you shipped}
BUILD.antipattern: flux_compile then flux_test as two calls; editing before claiming; skipping predict and OOMing the linker.

UI_DEPLOY.when: deploy or change a browser-facing surface in dist-final
combo: flux_ui_list                     # see what's already live, don't edit the stale dev mirror
flux_ui_read {file}              # production state, not your working copy
edit content in memory
flux_ui_deploy {file, content}   # atomic overwrite, returns cache-busted ?v= URL
hand the ?v= URL to the human
UI_DEPLOY.antipattern: raw cp into dist-final (loses cache-bust -> human reloads -> sees stale page -> blames the deploy).

combo: market_scan / dex_get_quote      # live data
qwen_trade_prepare               # proposer LLM frames the trade
run_debate: independent auditor LLM + M-of-N crypto sign (flux-debate)
dex_swap ONLY on DebateOutcome::Settle, else log the VETO and stop
TRADE.antipattern: single greedy proposer with money tools (it picks the MOON honeypot -> 95% loss). No auditor = no trade.

combo: flux_architect_predict + flux_heatmap   # predict before running
flux_combo / megaflood / chronos_run     # run the real benchmark
flux_bench / flux_bench_report           # capture numbers from a FILE, never assert them
flux_feedback {predicted, actual}        # calibrate the predictor
BENCH.antipattern: quoting test counts or bench numbers before the op ran and output was read from a file.

COMPUTE.when: need a GPU/CPU box for LLM serving or heavy compile
combo: search_offers                    # REST; surface offers to operator
(OPERATOR triggers) create_instance with onstart ollama serve, OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0
register_box {agent, id}         # box_registry so no teardown collision
... do the work ...
may_destroy(agent, id)  ->  destroy_instance
COMPUTE.antipattern: auto-renting (Viktor rejected this); create_instance leaks server-side even on a shown 'reject' -> always show_instances + destroy leaks.

ZK.when: prove/verify a SIGIL tip or batch
combo: flux_zk_combo / flux_zk_verify_10ms
flux_zk_pq_status                # confirm post-quantum + O(1)-verify path
ZK.antipattern: treating ZK as a throughput lever; it is a verify/light-client lever (prove() caps below ed25519).
